Split adm1: questionnaire self-report and examiner visual-acuity assessment must not share one mixed Administration. Add the reported recall periods to the applicable questionnaire administrations: past 12 months for service use, purchases, employment, sick leave, travel, and specified treatments; past 3 months for topical ophthalmic medication; past month for informal care; and past year plus current aid ownership for low-vision support. Split du3 and du4 into one DataUse per actual source. Do not combine government price lists, supplier quotations, Ministry communications, published low-vision-aid costs, and public documents in one DataUse. Also separate the population estimate, earnings data, life-expectancy input, value-of-statistical-life input, GDP deflator, and exchange-rate source. Preserve the selected WHO disability weights exactly: 0.047 for near VI, 0.005 for mild distance VI, 0.089 for moderate distance VI, 0.314 for severe distance VI, and 0.338 for blindness. Add the central productivity limitation that individual income was not collected, so productivity loss was derived from employment gaps and population earnings.
